views.name: v_atom_molecule
views.create_sql: /* Views thu cong cho database toxicology (Paper V-SQL style) */ /* 1. View ket hop atom va molecule */ CREATE VIEW v_atom_molecule AS SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.molecule_id, atom.element, molecule.label AS molecule_label FROM atom LEFT JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id

views.name: v_bond_molecule
views.create_sql: /* 2. View ket hop bond va molecule */ CREATE VIEW v_bond_molecule AS SELECT bond.bond_id, bond.molecule_id, bond.bond_type, molecule.label AS molecule_label FROM bond LEFT JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
